Package io.telekom.orchest.adapter.mongo.config

Class MongoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.mongodb.config.MongoConfigurationSupport
org.springframework.data.mongodb.config.AbstractMongoClientConfiguration
io.telekom.orchest.adapter.mongo.config.MongoConfiguration
@Configuration @EnableTransactionManagement @EnableMongoAuditing(dateTimeProviderRef="auditingDateTimeProvider") @EnableMongoRepositories(basePackages={"io.telekom.orchest.adapter.mongo.repository","io.telekom.orchest.orchestrest.extensions"}) public class MongoConfiguration extends org.springframework.data.mongodb.config.AbstractMongoClientConfiguration
Configuration for MongoDB connectivity. Handles database connection, AWS IAM authentication (if configured), auditing, and transaction management.
